## Best Facebook Ads reporting tools by use case


### Best AI-powered Facebook Ads reporting tools


**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool)** **is the strongest option for AI-assisted reporting tied to creative decisions** . It classifies ad content, analyzes performance using brand and campaign context, detects changes, answers account questions, and turns findings into briefs for future tests.


**Superads** is a **lower-cost alternative** for automatic creative tagging and AI-generated reports. **Madgicx** is better for advertisers that want **AI analysis connected to Meta campaign optimization** .


### Best Facebook Ads reporting tools for enterprise teams


**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool)** **fits enterprise teams** that need custom metrics, attribution inputs, role-based dashboards, permissions, scheduled analysis, internal data connections, and API access. It can also **compare creative performance across Meta and other paid channels** .


**Supermetrics** is preferable when the main requirement is **moving Meta data into a warehouse or BI system** . **AgencyAnalytics** is better for agencies that prioritize **standardized client reports and white-label portals** .


### Best Facebook Ads reporting tools for ecommerce


**Triple Whale** is the **leading ecommerce option** . It connects Facebook Ads data with first-party attribution, store revenue, customer activity, products, and operating costs, allowing teams to **evaluate campaigns against revenue and profit** .


**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool)** is **better for larger ecommerce teams focused on creative analysis** , custom attribution inputs, and cross-channel learning. **Madgicx** suits advertisers that want Shopify reporting alongside Meta optimization.


### Best free Facebook Ads reporting tools


**Databox** provides the **best permanent free starting point** . Its free plan includes one dashboard, three data sources, 10 custom metrics, daily syncing, one user, and limited AI usage.


**Triple Whale** **also has a free plan** , but its reporting is **designed primarily for ecommerce** . Superads, Supermetrics, and AgencyAnalytics offer trials rather than permanent free reporting plans.


### Best tools for detailed Facebook Ads reporting


**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool)** is the strongest option when detailed reporting includes account, campaign, ad set, ad, creative asset, placement, audience, custom label, custom metric, and attribution data. It also analyzes the **hooks, messages, formats, and visual elements inside each creative** .


**Supermetrics** is preferable for **exact Meta queries sent to spreadsheets, BI tools, or warehouses** . **Motion** specializes in **visual creative, launch, retention, demographic, and placement analysis** .


## 1.[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) : Best for creative-led Facebook Ads reporting


[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) combines **Meta performance data with the content of each ad** , brand context, custom measurement rules, attribution inputs, and results from other creative-led channels.


- **Reporting depth:** Inspect account, campaign, ad set, ad, and creative-asset performance. Filter by campaign, copy, landing page, audience, age, gender, platform, and placement.
- **Creative analysis:** Analyze images, video, and copy using AI and custom labels for hooks, messages, offers, formats, creators, and audience angles.
- **Measurement:** Create calculated metrics, configure attribution windows, set campaign-specific winning criteria, and incorporate external attribution or internal data.
- **Automation:** Schedule reporting tasks, send findings through email or Slack, and configure alerts for performance changes or anomalies.
- **Reporting-to-action workflow:** Use findings to plan the next test, create briefs or scripts, generate variations, and publish approved ads through the Meta Ads API.
- **Best for:** Larger brands, agencies, and enterprise teams running frequent creative tests across multiple accounts or channels.
- **Limitations:**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/creative-reporting-tool) does not support white-label reporting or offer a public free plan. Its public materials do not specify a fixed historical-retention period or formal Meta discrepancy-resolution process.
- **Pricing:** Starter costs $1,500 per month for up to $100,000 in monthly ad spend and two ad accounts. Professional and Enterprise use custom pricing. All plans include unlimited team members.


## 2. AgencyAnalytics: Best for multi-client agency reporting


**AgencyAnalytics** turns Facebook Ads data into **repeatable client dashboards, reports, and portals** .


- **Reporting:** Cover campaigns, ad sets, ads, audiences, creative, goals, budgets, period comparisons, and calculated metrics.
- **Agency workflow:** Clone templates, create account roll-ups, manage client access, and apply agency branding to reports and portals.
- **Delivery:** Schedule reports or share branded PDFs, dashboards, live links, and client portals.
- **Best for:** Agencies managing many clients that need standardized reports and white-label delivery.
- **Limitations:** Meta ad-insight history is limited to 37 months. Some inactive-campaign data may be incomplete because of Meta API restrictions. It is a client-reporting layer rather than an independent attribution or content-analysis system.
- **Pricing:** $20 per client per month when billed annually, with a 14-day trial.


## 3. Triple Whale: Best for ecommerce attribution and profit reporting


**Triple Whale** connects Facebook Ads performance with **ecommerce orders, customer activity, first-party attribution, revenue, and costs** .


- **Reporting:** Analyze campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, products, customers, revenue, and profit.
- **Attribution:** Compare first-click, last-click, linear, multi-touch, and Triple Whale models across configurable lookback windows.
- **Ecommerce context:** Evaluate Meta campaigns using store revenue, product costs, payment fees, shipping costs, and other expenses.
- **Best for:** Ecommerce brands that need to reconcile Facebook Ads activity with sales and profitability.
- **Limitations:** Triple Pixel requires correctly implemented tracking parameters, and attribution does not retroactively backfill activity from before setup. The product is less suitable for non-commerce businesses.
- **Pricing:** A free plan is available. Paid pricing varies by annual order revenue and package.


## 4. Supermetrics: Best for custom Facebook Ads reporting pipelines


**Supermetrics** retrieves **granular Meta data** and sends it to spreadsheets, BI tools, warehouses, dashboards, or custom reporting systems.


- **Reporting:** Select the required accounts, metrics, dimensions, filters, date ranges, placements, devices, audiences, and geographic breakdowns.
- **Destinations:** Refresh data in Google Sheets, Excel, Looker Studio, Power BI, BigQuery, Snowflake, and other supported destinations.
- **Control:** Use templates, destination formulas, custom Hub fields, Supermetrics Studio, or the API to build the reporting layer.
- **Best for:** Analysts and marketing operations teams that want to control where Facebook Ads data is stored and modeled.
- **Limitations:** Meta limits ad-insight history to 37 months. Connector-level custom metrics must be created through Hub fields or destination formulas. Entry plans limit users, destinations, and accounts.
- **Pricing:** Starter begins at $44 per month when billed annually, with a 14-day trial.


## 5. Motion: Best for visual Facebook Ads creative reporting


**Motion** places **Facebook ad assets beside their performance data** so teams can analyze creative without matching separate files to spreadsheet rows.


- **Reporting:** Compare individual creatives, grouped assets, concepts, creators, formats, landing pages, audiences, and placements.
- **Creative detail:** Review launch performance, weekly leaders, declining ads, video retention, period changes, and creative fatigue.
- **AI support:** Use automatic tags, reporting prompts, alerts, and creative-analysis routines.
- **Best for:** Creative strategists and media buyers that need visual asset comparisons and launch reporting.
- **Limitations:** AI tagging requires at least 10 Meta creatives with spend in the previous 90 days. Some data enrichment requires Pro, and the product is less suited to financial or low-cost KPI reporting.
- **Pricing:** Starter costs $750 per month. Pro costs $1,200 per month, while Growth uses custom pricing.


## 6. Whatagraph: Best for presentation-ready Facebook Ads reports


**Whatagraph** converts Meta data into **visual reports, scheduled emails, branded PDFs, and shareable dashboards** .


- **Reporting:** Break down results by campaign, ad set, ad, creative, placement, demographic, device, location, and custom metric.
- **Report building:** Start with a template, blank report, or AI prompt, then modify widgets, filters, comparisons, and commentary.
- **Delivery:** Send scheduled emails or share live links, branded dashboards, and PDF reports.
- **Best for:** Agencies and internal teams producing polished stakeholder reports.
- **Limitations:** The entry plan requires annual billing and uses source credits. Each connected Facebook Ads account consumes reporting capacity.
- **Pricing:** The Max plan costs €699 per month when billed annually and includes a 14-day trial.


## 7. Superads: Best for AI-tagged Facebook Ads creative reports


**Superads** uses AI to **label the visual and textual content** of Facebook ads and build reports around those labels.


- **Reporting:** Group performance by campaign, ad set, ad, creative, copy, headline, CTA, placement, landing page, or AI label.
- **Creative analysis:** Compare formats, hooks, products, angles, visual styles, value propositions, and combinations of several attributes.
- **Sharing:** Publish interactive links or export reports as PDF, CSV, or Excel on Professional.
- **Best for:** Paid media teams that want self-serve creative tagging and flexible visual reports.
- **Limitations:** Custom metric formulas are not supported, data refreshes daily, and pricing increases with combined ad spend across connected accounts.
- **Pricing:** Professional starts at $125 per month when billed annually for up to $100,000 in monthly ad spend. A 14-day trial is available.


## 8. Madgicx: Best for Facebook Ads reporting with Meta optimization


**Madgicx** combines **Meta reporting with account analysis, creative insights** , campaign management, and prepared optimization actions.


- **Reporting:** Analyze accounts, campaigns, ad sets, audiences, creatives, funnel stages, and selected periods.
- **Dashboards:** Use reporting templates or a drag-and-drop builder, then share public links or PDF exports.
- **Connected actions:** Use AI account analysis and creative-fatigue findings to prepare budget, bid, campaign, or creative changes for approval.
- **Best for:** Ecommerce advertisers and media buyers that want reporting and Meta optimization in the same platform.
- **Limitations:** Optimization is Meta-specific even though dashboards can include other sources. Server-side Tracking Pro costs extra, and pricing rises with monthly ad spend.
- **Pricing:** Plans start at $45 per month and include a seven-day trial.


## 9. GoodMorning: Best for weekly Facebook Ads diagnoses


**GoodMorning** uses read-only Meta access to produce a **pre-analyzed weekly report and prioritized action list** .


- **Reporting:** Review campaign, ad set, ad, creative fatigue, spend efficiency, and four-week performance trends.
- **Diagnosis:** Receive up to five recommended actions grouped by urgency, with campaign statuses and written explanations.
- **Delivery:** Reports appear every Monday through a dashboard and branded PDF.
- **Best for:** Meta-first teams that want a completed weekly diagnosis instead of an open-ended dashboard builder.
- **Limitations:** GoodMorning is Meta-only, priced per ad account, and limited to a fixed weekly format. Recommendations must be implemented elsewhere, and reports are not fully white-labeled.
- **Pricing:** $199 per account monthly, $179 with quarterly billing, or $159 with annual billing.


## 10. Databox: Best free Facebook Ads reporting dashboard


**Databox** connects to Facebook Ads with read-only access and turns Meta data into **no-code dashboards, reports, alerts, and AI summaries** .


- **Reporting:** Analyze account, campaign, ad set, and ad-level results using templates, custom dashboards, calculated metrics, and period comparisons.
- **Monitoring:** Set goals and alerts, review forecasts and benchmarks, and use Genie for summaries or questions about connected data.
- **Delivery:** Share dashboards or send reports through email and Slack on eligible plans.
- **Best for:** Solo marketers and small teams that need a basic free Facebook Ads KPI dashboard.
- **Limitations:** The free plan includes one user, three data sources, one dashboard, 10 custom metrics, daily syncing, and 50 monthly AI credits. Sharing, exports, faster syncing, additional users, agency tools, and white-labeling require paid plans or add-ons.
- **Pricing:** A free plan is available. Agency plans start at $79 per month when billed annually. White-label branding costs an additional $80 per month.
